negative_reviews.author: Susan McKenna
negative_reviews.text: More expensive than wagamamas and not as nice. They add a tip to the bill without consent. We are not in the US, doing this is ignorant and offensive. Poor behaviour. Do better.

negative_reviews.author: Josie Adamson
negative_reviews.text: Food was mediocre and not really all that authentic. Service is terrible could just be the staff we had this day but not attentive enough and forgetful even tho there weren’t many customers. Don’t have normal soy sauce only gluten free which is no good, no options
